title: "Going to Church Doesn’t Make You a Christian – Knowing Jesus Does" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Going to Church Doesn’t Make You a Christian – Knowing Jesus Does" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 A shocking truth: Not everyone in church is truly saved.

Sitting in a church does not make you a Christian any more than sitting in a garage makes you a car.
Reading the Bible does not guarantee you know Jesus unless you obey Him.
Saying "I'm a Christian" means nothing if your life doesn’t reflect Christ.
📖 “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven.” (Matthew 7:21)
💡 Jesus didn’t come to create churchgoers—He came to save souls.

🔥 The Truth: Religion Can’t Save You – Only Jesus Can
Many people think they are saved because they:
✅ Go to church every Sunday.
✅ Own a Bible and know verses.
✅ Pray when they need something.

But Jesus didn’t say, "Attend church and be saved."
He said:
📖 “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” (John 14:6)
🚨 Christianity is not a religion—it’s a relationship with Jesus Christ.

🔥 Why Church Attendance Alone is Not Enough
1️⃣ Jesus is Looking for a Relationship, Not a Routine
Many people show up to church but don’t show up in their walk with Jesus.
📖 “This people honors Me with their lips, but their heart is far from Me.” (Matthew 15:8)
💡 Christianity is not about religious activities—it’s about knowing Jesus personally.

2️⃣ The Pharisees Went to ‘Church’ Every Day – And Still Went to Hell
The Pharisees were experts in religion, yet Jesus called them hypocrites.

📖 “You study the Scriptures diligently because you think that in them you have eternal life. These are the very Scriptures that testify about Me, yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.” (John 5:39-40)
🚨 Knowing ABOUT Jesus is not the same as KNOWING Jesus.

3️⃣ Faith Without Obedience is Dead
Going to church without true faith is like owning a gym membership but never exercising.
📖 “Faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.” (James 2:17)
💡 A true Christian doesn’t just listen to the Word—they live it out.

🔥 How Do You Know If You’re Truly a Christian?
Jesus gave clear signs of what a real Christian looks like:
✅ 1. You have a personal relationship with Jesus.

You don’t just talk about God—you talk to Him daily.
📖 “This is eternal life: that they know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.” (John 17:3)
✅ 2. Your life is transformed by the Holy Spirit.

You repent from sin and strive to live in holiness.
📖 “If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; the old has passed away, the new has come.” (2 Corinthians 5:17)
✅ 3. You obey Jesus’ commands.

It’s not about just believing—it’s about following.
📖 “Whoever has My commands and keeps them is the one who loves Me.” (John 14:21)
🔥 Warning: Many Churchgoers Will Be Shocked on Judgment Day
Jesus said that many people will think they are saved, only to hear these terrifying words:
📖 “I never knew you. Depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness.” (Matthew 7:23)
🚨 Going to church won’t save you. Knowing Jesus will.

🔥 How to Truly Follow Jesus (Not Just Be Religious)
1️⃣ Repent and Believe in Jesus Christ Alone.

Going to church doesn’t save you—Jesus does.
📖 “Unless you repent, you will all perish.” (Luke 13:3)
2️⃣ Commit to a Daily Relationship with Jesus.

Read the Bible, pray, and obey His Word every day.
📖 “Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you.” (James 4:8)
3️⃣ Live Out Your Faith in Public, Not Just in Church.

Christianity is 24/7, not just Sunday mornings.
📖 “Let your light shine before others.” (Matthew 5:16)
🚀 The real proof of your faith is not inside the church—it’s in how you live every day.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 18, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to KNOW Jesus, not just go to church. I surrender my heart fully to Him and commit to a real relationship with Christ—not just religious habits."

🔥 THE “KNOW JESUS” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly saved, or just religious?
✅ Step 2: If you’re truly saved, share your testimony today.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and challenge them to evaluate their faith.

🌌 DON'T JUST GO TO CHURCH – BE THE CHURCH 🌌
📖 “Be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.” (James 1:22)

👉 It’s time to stop playing church and start following Jesus for real.
👉 Eternity is too long to be wrong. Make sure your faith is real today.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 18, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for showing me that salvation is not about a title but a true relationship with Jesus Christ. I repent from trusting in my own goodness or traditions, and today, I put my full faith in Jesus alone. Help me to live as a true follower, walking in obedience and love for You.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
